title: DrawTalk Harness
An animation tool that learns your language
Built today · MongoDB Atlas + Vector Search · no preset motions
end: Every change it makes to itself is a MongoDB document
segments: Characters are drawn as vector ink. The behavior library starts EMPTY.
"the rabbit and the turtle race towards the rock"
The LLM writes two NEW behaviors: dash (rabbit) and plod (turtle)
Speed comes from each character's nature: quick rabbit, slow turtle
Scene 2 continues from scene 1. A gesture + "the rabbit sleeps"...
...teaches a new behavior, nap, and saves the gesture as a drawn word
A drawn path: "the turtle plods through towards the tree"
Reuses plod v1 (found via Atlas Vector Search) along the path
Refinement: "the turtle should move faster this time"
The harness proposes plod v2 with a diff and a regression replay
Scope confirmed: v2 saved in MongoDB, clips re-simulated
Scene 3: "the rabbit wakes up and dashes towards the tree"
A new behavior is composed. Too late: the turtle already won.
The same gesture on the turtle, with NO words...
Fast path: recognized with no LLM call. Nap transfers to the turtle.
Learning curve: the share of commands that need the LLM keeps falling
Play story: three scenes, every clip pinned to a behavior version
